### run_opencode — ralph.py

**Purpose:** Runs one non-interactive opencode session (`opencode run --print-logs --log-level ERROR --model opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free <prompt>`) from the repo root with no timeout, streaming merged stdout+stderr line by line. On the first line indicating a rate limit it terminates the session (instead of letting opencode silently wait the limit out — observed ~2.8 h retry-after on the free tier) and reports the wait so the caller can hand off to freebuff.
arguments.new_string:
### build_agent_command — ralph.py

**Purpose:** Builds the argv for one non-interactive agent session: `claude -p <prompt> --model claude-fable-5` when the user opted into claude mode (module global `claude_mode_enabled`), otherwise `opencode run --print-logs --log-level ERROR --model opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free <prompt>`.

**Parameters:**
- `prompt: str` — the full message for the session. Non-empty.

**Returns:** `list[str]` — the command argv.

**Side effects:** None.

**Raises:** Nothing.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `run_opencode`, tests. Calls nothing.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-10 — initial implementation.

### ask_use_claude — ralph.py

**Purpose:** Interactive three-gate opt-in to claude mode at ralph startup: asks whether to use claude instead of opencode, whether the user is signed in to claude, and a final are-you-sure confirmation warning that it will use Fable 5 (very expensive). Any non-yes answer aborts to opencode; declining the sign-in gate also prints a hint to sign in first.

**Parameters:** None.

**Returns:** `bool` — True only when all three questions are answered yes.

**Side effects:** Reads three answers from stdin; prints the fallback hint on the sign-in decline.

**Raises:** `EOFError` — stdin closed (non-interactive invocation).

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `main`. Calls `wants_resume`, input.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-10 — initial implementation.

### run_opencode — ralph.py

**Purpose:** Runs one non-interactive agent session (command from `build_agent_command`: opencode by default, `claude -p ... --model claude-fable-5` in claude mode) from the repo root with no timeout, streaming merged stdout+stderr line by line. On the first line indicating a rate limit it terminates the session (instead of letting opencode silently wait the limit out — observed ~2.8 h retry-after on the free tier) and reports the wait so the caller can hand off to freebuff.
